subject: *: rename variable tidb_kv_read_timeout to tikv_client_read_timeout and remove tidb_kv_read_timeout stmt hint (#46714)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent: the sysvar rename to `tikv_client_read_timeout` is propagated consistently through `SessionVars`, `kv.Request`/options, snapshot read-timeout plumbing, and coprocessor request timeout selection. The dedicated `TIDB_KV_READ_TIMEOUT()` hint is removed end-to-end (parser token/grammar, AST restore/tests, planner hint handling, stmtctx fields), while statement-scoped override remains supported via `SET_VAR(tikv_client_read_timeout=...)` (applied in `planner/optimize.go` before executor builds requests). No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn behavior, or KV/store runtime handling; upstream/master contains no later fix-ups indicating a latent bug in this change.
